title: beszel-agent: add dataDir option
reason: Applicable: changed-file list includes nixos/modules/services/monitoring/beszel-agent.nix. Wired test confirmed: nixos/tests/all-tests.nix at head (6183d419) contains 'beszel = runTest ./beszel.nix;' (line 279), and nixos/tests/beszel.nix exercises services.beszel.agent.enable=true in a two-node (hub+agent) test via a specialisation.
targets_toml: single target beszel-agent, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,beszel,agent], watch=[enable, dataDir]. The real diff adds `dataDir = lib.mkOption { type = lib.types.path; default = "/var/lib/beszel-agent"; ... }` (a genuinely new option declaration), so dataDir was watched alongside baseline enable.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Non-PASS transition (test does not set services.beszel.agent.dataDir, so the test file never exercises the new option; head module declares dataDir but no predicate over it was found witnessed by the test). Does not qualify as a PASS-involving asymmetric transition per the strict criterion, but is the only changed watched identity for this PR and drove raw.json's oba_verdict_transitions['option_not_found->predicate_not_found']=1. Flagging since exit codes were non-zero (2) on all three commands even though JSON output was well-formed and complete (tool_error=false); nonzero exit appears to be oba's normal signal for 'non-clean' (inconclusive/changed) results, consistent with an earlier batch (538178) where exit 0 correlated with all-PASS/unchanged results.
